beats.narration: Mia, at 8 years old I said I wanted to be a scientist. Mom got very excited and seemed proud. I was quiet. I wore sunglasses everywhere and loved battling Yugioh cards.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Quiet pride and wonder in being seen by Mom.

beats.narration: At 17 my license gave me my first taste of freedom. I drove my 2000 Honda Accord Coupe with faded paint and no air conditioning. I added an aux converter to play my tunes.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Bright freedom and ownership in a first car.

beats.narration: I graduated early from McKinney Boyd High School by doubling my first and second semesters. After bootcamp in Python and Ruby on Rails, at 19 I got my first 50k software engineering job and stopped worrying about money.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Steady pride and relief in earning a real job.

beats.narration: I met my wife on a dating app for Muslims from Dallas to Chicago. Her 8pm Facetime every week made me fall in love. Mia, I love you very much even if I may not always show it.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Gentle constancy turning into lasting father love.
